subject: Global technical bootcamp — proposed rotating kickoff windows
messages:
From: Janet Li <janet.li@fintechcorp.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: infra@fintechcorp.com, Akira Sato <akira.sato@payments-inc.jp>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC bootcamp coordination — global windows and activities

Hi Alex,

Thanks for confirming Redwood for our three-week bootcamp. We want the kickoff to include: prompt review, routing sanity checks, and a short load test (smoke level) so we can validate operational behavior across regions.

High-level constraints from our side:
- US product and SRE folks: generally available 10:00–13:00 PT (Pacific).
- EU engineering: typically 14:00–18:00 CET.
- APAC (Tokyo/SG): mornings 09:00–12:00 JST/SGT.

Can you propose a rotating schedule that gives each region at least one kickoff-friendly time inside those windows across three days? Also important: we need a dedicated 90-minute hands-on slot for the load test that we can record.

Attachments: participant-timezones.csv (simple availability matrix).

If you can send a couple of candidate windows (with UTC times) and who from your team will lead each activity, we’ll lock calendars ASAP.

Appreciate it —
Janet
Janet Li
Head of Integrations, FintechCorp
janet.li@fintechcorp.com
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Janet Li <janet.li@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC bootcamp coordination — global windows and activities

Janet — thanks for the clear constraints. Below are three rotation proposals (all times in UTC with local equivalents):

Option A (US-friendly kickoff):
- Day 1 kickoff (prompt review + routing brief): 17:00 UTC (10:00 PT / 18:00 CET / 02:00 JST next day) — 60 minutes
- Day 2 hands-on load test: 18:00 UTC (11:00 PT / 19:00 CET / 03:00 JST) — 90 minutes (recorded)

Option B (EU-friendly kickoff):
- Day 1 kickoff: 15:00 UTC (08:00 PT / 16:00 CET / 00:00 JST) — 60 minutes
- Day 2 hands-on load test: 16:00 UTC (09:00 PT / 17:00 CET / 01:00 JST) — 90 minutes

Option C (APAC-friendly kickoff):
- Day 1 kickoff: 07:00 UTC (00:00 PT / 09:00 CET / 16:00 JST) — 60 minutes
- Day 2 hands-on load test: 08:00 UTC (01:00 PT / 10:00 CET / 17:00 JST) — 90 minutes

Quick notes on trade-offs: the load test needs a consistent 90-minute window and at least one hour of pre-checks. If we rotate the kickoff, we should keep the load test at a predictable offset so SRE can allocate capacity.

Proposed ownership from Redwood:
- Prompt review (template + quick eval): Kimberly Park — will prepare a prompt checklist and sample evals.
- Routing sanity + canary traffic: Rishi Malhotra — will coordinate routing policies and test vectors.
- Load tests (smoke): Tessa Morgan — will run scaled-up requests on Dedicated/dev pool and capture latency/cost metrics.

CCing Kimberly, Rishi, and Tessa to confirm availability for the three options. If one of these options looks good to you, we’ll push calendar invites and the .ics for the hands-on slot.

— Alex
Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Thanks — confirming the owners listed by Alex. Quick operational items from my side:

- I’ll assemble the prompt review kit and a 20-min checklist doc (will attach prod-test-plan.xlsx).
- Prefer Option A for day-1 kickoff (US-friendly) with the load-test on Day 2 at 18:00 UTC. That gives our SREs overlap with EU on pre-checks.
- Rishi: please confirm routing test vectors (happy to add a short session to the kickoff agenda for them).
- Tessa: can you provision a dev pool and share the capacity numbers (gpus / qps) by EOD Thu?

- Tessa: provisioning notes + invite the infra contact at FintechCorp to the load test slot

Alex / Kimberly — thanks for the clear plan and ownership. A couple of updates from our side:

1) Exec conflict — our Head of Product will be unavailable the afternoon of Day 1 (EU) and requested the kickoff be moved earlier by ~2 hours if possible. That would shift Option A kickoff from 17:00 UTC to 15:00 UTC on Day 1.
2) We’ve attached a refreshed participant-timezones.csv with exact attendees and their offsets.
3) We still need the 90-minute hands-on load test; can that be rescheduled to 16:00 UTC instead of 18:00 UTC on Day 2 to accommodate APAC participants?

If you can confirm availability for the adjusted windows (Day 1 kickoff 15:00 UTC; Day 2 load test 16:00 UTC) we’ll issue calendar invites and loop infra for access (infra@fintechcorp.com).

Thanks —
Janet
